name: Glass Button

semanticTypeCandidates.evidence: Primary action control across dialogs, composer, window toolbars
Circular glass icon buttons in reference player (bell, settings, shuffle)
Thinking-mode / tool toggles in chat composer

representativeVariants.whySelected: Signature control: in dark theme primary is a pure-white elevated button with soft shadow (the play button in reference)
Default translucent glass button used for most secondary actions
40px circular glass icon button — top-bar bell/settings and player transport language
Glass interaction feedback must stay subtle: brighten fill on hover, scale 0.97 on press

structurePatterns: Icon + label horizontally centered, gap var(--space-2)
All buttons share the glass six-pack: translucent fill, hairline border, top inset highlight, backdrop blur+saturate, soft shadow, large radius
Focus-visible: 2px ring via --color-primary at 55% alpha, 2px offset

usageHints.do: Use one primary per view; prefer glass variant for parallel actions; circle icon for toolbars
usageHints.avoid: Never stack blur on more than 2 overlapping button layers; never use heavy drop shadows on glass buttons

unknowns: Exact pressed duration token resolved at motion phase
keyInsightSeed: White in dark, ink in light — the primary button is the one opaque moment in a translucent world.
